body: Coordinator rule (Termal::Fable2, 2026-10-18 22:29Z, from four compile-only misses in one day: Coder m5 RED E0308, Sol-8e1f A1 green1 E0063, Sol-a7bb M4 E0596, Codex-WorkspaceLookupsFresh observer E0063, the last caught by its review pair). Before a worker freezes source that ADDS a field to a struct, or changes a type or signature, require a source-read inventory with rg (no cargo) of EVERY struct-literal construction and every call site of the changed item across src/, including src/tests/. The READY lists each site with its file, line and status. Struct-update syntax and Default sites count as covered. Launching the review pair before the run is also worth it: it catches compile blockers without spending a run slot. Each compile-only failure wastes a cold slot of about 3-4 min while gates are the bottleneck.
